name: DianSheng Galaxy Corner-Turning 3x3 (Magnetic + Ball-Core)
description: The DianSheng Corner-Turning 3x3 (Core Magnetic) is a revolutionary twist on the classic 3x3 puzzle. Featuring unique cuts on each corner, this shape mod allows for smooth, independent corner rotations—without sacrificing traditional 3x3 functionality. Inside, a core magnetization system with adjustable tension ensures excellent stability and speed, meeting the expectations of competitive cubers and collectors alike.
